summary: Apps from what is installed. New workbench/apps_catalog.py (no Qt) reads the XDG desktop entries (the owner's folder first, then XDG_DATA_DIRS; the first id wins; Hidden masks, NoDisplay and TryExec honoured, OnlyShowIn/NotShowIn loosely against XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP plus 'Graphite'; localised Name/GenericName/Comment/Keywords), groups each app under its first main category in plain words, finds its icon in the icon themes (GTK theme, Adwaita, what they inherit, hicolor, pixmaps) or falls back to Graphite's glyph for its group, searches by word prefix, and turns Exec into argv with %f %F %u %U %i %c %k %% (never a shell; a field code inside a quoted argument is never filled; terminal apps run under x-terminal-emulator/xterm -e argv; every start goes through session_launch.launch, in a session of its own). File kinds: the MIME type from the shared MIME database's globs2 (then mimetypes, then a text check), with aliases and subclasses; the default from the mimeapps.list files in the spec's order, honouring Removed Associations; Open with = the default, Added Associations, the MimeType declarers, then parent types. set_default writes only the owner's $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mimeapps.list (keeps every other line, atomic) and reads it back (verified). Kernel ops: apps.list and apps.for (read, observers), apps.open, apps.pin and apps.unpin (execute), apps.default (approve: the owner's press only). New workbench/apps_qt.py: the Apps panel (AppsPanel, a ProgramsList subclass, so hatch.programs, rows_by_key, Explore, the game and the desk acts keep working) with a search line and ⊕ at the top, Yours (pins), the installed apps under category headings, then Graphite's rooms under 'Graphite'; ⊕ beside Apps in the head ('Add an app to the list': an entry or a typed command, no shell); Open with on a file's right-click (Files, the Finder, the left tree's Files drawer, a FILE tile on the board, a viewer target); an OpenWithDialog with 'Always open PDF files with this'; an Open with… button in the universal viewer; Files' 'Open with this computer's app' now opens the default app through the Kernel.

existing_tests_changed: tests_integrated/test_launcher.py: test_type_to_select_jumps_to_the_rows_by_their_first_letters replaced by test_typing_finds_the_rows_by_their_words. Why: the list is now the Apps panel with a search line at its top and the typing goes to that line however the panel opens, so 'a keyboard opening starts at Agenda' and 'K jumps to KiBot outputs' are no longer true. The new test points the XDG folders at empty folders (no installed app of the machine is listed) and checks: focus in the search line; 'kic' leaves ['KiCad checks']; Down reaches it; a letter typed on a row returns to the line ('kicx', nothing left, said so); the first Escape clears, the second closes. Not run (the owner's rule); the same sequence is in the smoke script and passed. The other launcher tests stay true: installed rows are built only when the panel opens, and headings are not rows and are not in words().
decisions: The Apps list stays one object: AppsPanel subclasses programs_qt.ProgramsList and replaces it in hatch_qt, so the head's Apps button, desk_doers (go_app, head_open), rows_by_key and the System-menu metric checks keep working. Order in the panel: search line and ⊕, Yours (pins), the installed apps by category (A to Z, Other last), then Graphite's rooms under a 'Graphite' heading (shown only when anything else is in the panel).

In this panel search replaces type-to-select (the coordinator asked for a search line at the top): the typing goes to the line on opening; a letter typed on a row goes to the line; Down and Up move between the line and the rows; the line's Return opens the first row left; Escape clears, then closes. Search matches word prefixes ('rail' does not find 'Work trail').

A field code inside a quoted Exec argument is never filled (the spec calls it undefined; such an argument is often read by sh -c, where a file name could become a command): the entry is said not to take files. The same rule refuses a pinned command with a quoted file code.

Local files given to %u/%U are passed as file:// addresses (as GLib does); files are made whole paths before a launch so a file name is never read as an option; an address starting with '-' is refused.

An app whose program is not installed is listed quietly with the words 'cannot start here' and says why when chosen (a missing TryExec hides it, as the spec allows). NoDisplay and OnlyShowIn-elsewhere apps are left out of the list but are still offered by Open with and by ⊕ (Add an app to the list shows every app, with why it is not listed).
Category headings in plain words; 'Development' rather than 'Programming' (clear of the 'Programs' word).

Defaults are written only to the owner's own $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mimeapps.list ([Default Applications], the app first in [Added Associations], out of [Removed Associations]); an empty id takes the owner's line back out (the undo). apps.default is approve scope, so her principal (read, execute) can never set it; the Open with rows are not on desk_acts.MENU_ROWS, so her hand cannot choose them.
Pins (Yours) are kept in Graphite's profile folder (ARC1_WORKBENCH_CONFIG_HOME, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/arc1-workbench/apps.json), not as desktop entries in the owner's applications folder.

The MIME type is read in pure Python from the shared MIME database (globs2, aliases, subclasses; no Qt, so the Kernel and the window agree); no magic-number sniffing beyond 'is it text'. Type words come from a small table ('PDF files'), else the file's extension.

Open with in the right-click is on the first level for kinds without a REST table (a viewer's datasheet) and under More › Open and show for files (REST for 'file' left unchanged, so no first-level check moves); opening the right-click reads nothing (the rows are read when Open with opens).

For 'the reference/document views': the universal viewer (any file opened read-only) gets an 'Open with…' button in its actions row (it folds into More… like the others); Kernel documents (document_qt pages) are records, not files, and get nothing.

activity.OBSERVER_OPERATIONS: 'apps.list','apps.for' added inside the existing list after L1's entries.

For L2 (FILE tiles) and L4 ('Open in the full program'): apps_qt.open_default(host, path) opens a file with its default app (Open with when there is none) and apps_qt.open_with_file(host, path) shows Open with; the right-click provider already handles Field targets whose object target is {'kind':'file','path':<absolute>}. For S5 (Settings): apps_catalog.default_for / apps_for / set_default and the Kernel's apps.for / apps.default. For S3/A1: session_launch.launched() lists what Apps started.

LS_XSESSION.sh does not set XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP; Graphite answers to 'Graphite' in OnlyShowIn/NotShowIn regardless. Exporting XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=Graphite in the session (S1's file, not changed here) would let other programs see it too.
xdg-utils (in the 1.0 package list) is not needed by Open with, which reads mimeapps.list itself; other programs' 'open this link' honour the same file.
not_done: No tests were run (the owner's rule) and nothing ran on the ThinkPad: real installed apps, real icon themes and real launches were seen only with invented stand-ins in a throwaway XDG tree.
D-Bus-activatable entries without an Exec are listed as 'cannot start here' (Graphite does not start apps over D-Bus).
No magic-number MIME detection (globs only, plus a text check).

The Settings page for default programs is S5's; Kernel documents (document_qt) have no Open with (they are records, not files); the reference room (ReferenceTab) has no Open with of its own beyond the universal viewer.
release_note: Apps are what is installed: the Apps panel (upper right) lists the programs on this computer from their desktop entries, by kind, with their own icons and a search line, and keeps Graphite's own rooms under their own heading; ⊕ beside Apps puts any app, or a command of your own, on your list. Files open with their default app or with Open with (right-click, or the viewer's Open with…), and 'Always open PDF files with this' sets the default in your own settings, read back before it is said to be done. Every app starts in a session of its own, never through a shell, so it stays open if Graphite restarts.
